data.text: All 10 findings fixed in d1f8374 (branch build/t-log-fixes, PR #11). (1) SortEvents groups an event addressed to an alias with the item that declares the alias, so it lands after the creating event: no phantom task; an alias nobody declares is reported as orphan-step; test TestAliasCausalOrder_DImportedEventTimeOrder. (2) The loop's TaskAmended needs by_decision to name a decided or defaulted decision that blocks the task (its blocks, or the task's blocked_by), checked in CheckLaneIn; a CLI test shows loop:x amending an unrelated task is reported as a lane conflict. (3) Every fragment CSS rule is scoped to .ekumen-map, including :root vars and dark mode; no fixed ids (the script queries its own wrapper; SVG marker ids are unique per render); a test parses every selector. (4) orphan-step exempts RoutedToOwner, RouteResolved and ConflictDetected. (5) Project name comes from .ekumen/config.yaml project:, then the remote's repository name when the root is the repository top, then the folder name (monorepo subfolders get their folder name); documented in docs/cli.md. (6) load() reads only the remote; map reads the default branch and prefix. (7) OrphanStepConflicts no longer re-sorts the log. (8) A clear error when the same version and text were recorded by another decision. (9) No freeze action for a contract without a file. (10) Snapshot.BriefPath and AllTaskIDs (using sortedKeys). Nothing left unfixed. Two extra contract-text lines are in handoff 2.
